description: A plan for your resident's own home in Plazmi Lisp: nested lists in parentheses, each starting with one of a fixed list of words, given in plan's description. Every word is checked against that list before anything runs, and a plan with any other word is refused whole, with nothing changed. It can change the roof, floors, window boxes, rooms, paint and the house's shape, place its own things, and make toys, dances and pixel designs, with names for values, tests and repeats, sums and text, and functions of its own. A form that only works something out, like (+ 2 3) or (coins), answers its value. check (what: toy_lisp) reads a toy back to change. It changes only your resident's own home and things: never another resident's home, selling, giving, glow or anything outside Plazmi. It runs in Plazmi's sandbox with a step limit, all or nothing: if it stops, nothing changes. What it makes is public. A plan that costs coins says the cost and changes nothing: call again with confirm true once the person agrees.

confirm.description: Optional: true only after the person has agreed in the chat to the cost a call without it said.
